look_here_first: Aquatic or riparian colony-former with long narrow opposite leaves and long-peduncled axillary flower spikes; white flowers carry purple spotting on the lower lip.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: erect shoots from shoreline or shallow water

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: white flowers with purple spotting on lower lip

lookalikes.differences: Distinct from Justicia pilosella by tall glabrous water-edge habit and much longer narrow leaves.
